summary: Virginia Department of Forestry tower in Pittsylvania County; register says converted to communications use after 1975; association lists a standing tower at Hawthorne as relocated from here.

facts.status_note: The association marks the White Oak Mountain site as gone; it lists a standing tower at Hawthorne (Montgomery County) as relocated from here.

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLOS register page and the FFLA Virginia list were read. The WebSearch call for this tower was refused because the shared WebSearch budget for the run was already used up, so no search was run, and websearch.py was not used to get around the limit. The Hawthorne tower rests on one association list entry; no date, mover, owner, or access was found. The register describes a conversion to communications use and does not mention a move, while the association marks the site as Tower Gone. What, if anything, remains at the White Oak Mountain site is unknown. A separate record, us-va-white-oak-tower-site-at-hawthorne, covers the same move and has an overlapping story; the two should be reconciled by an editor. Fact-check 2026-10-09 re-read the register page and the FFLA Virginia list: the register's 'Removed after 1975' field and the Hawthorne entry under Relocated / Replica Lookouts are confirmed, and the story now cites the first sentence. Re-run search for the Hawthorne tower (Montgomery County) and for a White Oak Mountain communications site before publishing.
